title: upfly refs --json: the result
description: The last line upfly refs <image> --json prints: every reference to that one image, whether a run could rewrite each, every other line that names its path, which Upfly does not follow, and what upfly optimize would do with it. Read references and unfollowed together before changing the image. Progress lines come before it (events.json); an image that is missing, outside the project or not one Upfly found gives an error line with exit code 2 instead (events.json).

image.description: The image, relative to the project.

line.description: The line, counted from 1, or null when the file could not be read again.

rewritable.description: Whether a run could point it at a new file.

why.description: Why it stays as written. Present exactly when rewritable is false.

unfollowed.description: Every other line that names the image's path, found by a search of the project's files in any letter case and as a browser reads a path written percent-encoded or with HTML character references, which Upfly does not follow. When Upfly converts or moves the image, it rewrites the path in a comment along with the references, where it can tell the comment names this image, and every other line here stays as written. A line that names another file of the same name is not here. At most one entry per line.

text.description: The path as the line writes it, such as a whole address.

reason.description: Why Upfly does not follow it: a full address, which it never rewrites since it cannot tell which host is the site's own; a path built at runtime; a value in data or a component's props; a file type it does not read; a comment; or another reason, which why says.

loads.description: Whether a page can still load the image through this line, so a move breaks it unless somebody changes it by hand. False only where Upfly read the place and found that nothing loads it: a comment, a code example, or text a page shows. A value no reader takes a path from counts as loading.

host.description: The host, for a full address.

unsearchable.description: Files the search could not read, so a line in them naming the image cannot be ruled out. Present only when there is one.

verdict.description: What upfly optimize would do with the image, with the configured format and policy.

removesOriginal.description: true only under the replace policy, when every reference moves.

oneOf.description: No reference leads to it, and its name appears nowhere else. Upfly never deletes it.
No reference Upfly can follow leads to it, but its name appears where Upfly could not follow it. Read the mentions before treating it as unused.
